notes.title: Black cloth problem solved
notes.content:
We need to improve our vignette effect, but this update should allow all players to play without the dark cloth effect.

Sorry for the delay!

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
If you try our game, remember that you can leave us a review to recommend the game to other users... or tell us what we should improve!

notes.title: Everything's ready!
notes.content:
We finally have everything ready to publish our first VR title on Steam! Don't hesitate to support us by adding the game to your wish list and stay tuned on the 27th, where you can finally enjoy our little project.

Thank you for your support and we hope you will unlock all the mysteries that Grandma's Legacy has to offer!

[previewyoutube=wxykfgEi8k8;full][/previewyoutube]


PS: We hope you get all the achievements of our game, but if you are not an achievement fan... at least you should try the lighter.
